basics.summary: I am a web developer and graphics designer with a love for all things design. With over 5 years of experience, I've worked with clients across Logistics, Retail, and cutting-edge AI. My expertise includes building robust, scalable applications with C# and .NET, integrating REST APIs and databases, and, most recently, designing offline-first AI systems with Python and Ollama for clients with strict data-privacy requirements.

currentRole.label: Current Role
highlights: Leading a small development team under the Technical Lead, coordinating the design, implementation, and delivery of logistics-related features.

Refactored and rebuilt the entire Visualization module, redesigning its architecture and data flow to achieve up to a 3000x performance improvement while significantly simplifying the overall structure.
Led the development of numerous stock and inventory management enhancements, improving system performance, maintainability, and user workflows.
Led the development of the new YouCar.nl site, delivering new features across both frontend and backend systems.
Also shipped and continue to maintain CraigMarloch, Navigate North, and PlantBeeb — full websites (and companion apps) used daily by real customers.
Continue mentoring junior developers, reviewing code, and driving technical improvements across logistics-focused projects.

flagshipProject.name: Fully Offline, Secure AI Chatbot for Private Client Data
flagshipProject.summary: Designed and built an end-to-end, fully offline and self-hosted AI chatbot that lets a client query their own private business data without any information ever leaving their infrastructure, built for organizations with strict data-privacy, compliance, and security requirements.

details.description: Designed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline running entirely on-premises, with zero external API calls or third-party data transmission.
Integrated Ollama to run open-source large language models locally, giving the client full control over the model, its behavior, and its data footprint.
Built the core API, chat session management, and access-control layer in .NET, exposing secure endpoints for document ingestion, chat, and administration.
Developed the document processing pipeline in Python, parsing, chunking, and embedding client documents for semantic retrieval.

Used a self-hosted Qdrant instance as the dedicated vector store for embeddings, alongside PostgreSQL for chat history and document metadata, keeping the entire pipeline on-premises with no external vector-database dependency.
Delivered a fully air-gapped-capable deployment model, ensuring complete confidentiality of sensitive client data and satisfying internal security review requirements.
Gave the client a production-ready, private AI assistant over their own knowledge base, with no recurring API costs and no third-party data exposure.
